project.title: Unified Analytics Platform MVP for Product Usage Insights
project.objective: Design and ship an MVP analytics platform that centralises product usage data and exposes reliable dashboards and APIs for internal teams.
deliverables: Event tracking schema and instrumentation guidelines for core products
Data ingestion and transformation pipelines into a central warehouse
Curated analytics data models for product and growth teams
Internal web dashboard for key product usage KPIs
Service API for programmatic access to aggregated metrics
Technical runbook for operations, monitoring and incident response
constraints: MVP must be deployable on existing cloud infrastructure and tooling
Only anonymised and aggregated user data allowed; comply with privacy policies
Initial scope limited to two flagship products and top 10 events each
Dashboards must load in under 5 seconds for standard queries
Pipelines must support at least daily refresh with automated monitoring
All components must be maintainable by the existing engineering team

risks.risk: Event tracking is inconsistent across products, breaking downstream models.
risks.mitigation: Define strict tracking spec, add validation checks, and run a pilot on one product first.

risks.risk: Pipeline performance issues cause delayed dashboards and stale data.
risks.mitigation: Start with incremental loads, benchmark early, and add basic workload monitoring and alerts.

risks.risk: Privacy or security non-compliance in data handling.
risks.mitigation: Involve security officer in design reviews and implement anonymisation and access controls by default.

risks.risk: Scope creep on dashboard requirements from multiple teams.
risks.mitigation: Lock MVP metrics list, maintain a parking lot for v2, and get sign-off from product stakeholders.

themes.why_relevant: Consistent events are critical for reliable analytics and reduce rework in pipelines and dashboards.
Robust ingestion and transformation ensure timely, trustworthy metrics for decision-making.
Versioned schemas and models avoid breaking changes for downstream consumers and APIs.
Cloud resources and queries must be efficient to keep latency low and costs predictable.
Only authorised users should access sensitive data while complying with privacy constraints.
Clear MVP boundaries enable shipping on time and planning follow-up improvements.

backlog.task: Define and document unified event tracking schema for two flagship products
definition_of_done: Tracking spec doc covers top 10 events per product with properties and examples
Event naming and property conventions agreed with product stakeholders
Validation rules for events defined and shared with implementation teams

backlog.task: Implement data ingestion pipeline from product event streams into central storage
definition_of_done: Pipeline code deployed to cloud environment with automated runs
Events from both products land in raw storage within 15 minutes of emission
Basic monitoring and alerting configured for ingestion failures

backlog.task: Design and build core transformation jobs to create clean analytics tables
definition_of_done: Transformation logic implemented for sessions, users, and feature usage tables
Jobs scheduled with dependency management and logging
Data quality checks (row counts, null checks) implemented and passing

backlog.task: Create curated semantic data models for product and growth analytics
definition_of_done: Dimensional models for users, features, and time created and documented
Models validated with sample queries from data analyst
Versioning approach for models agreed and recorded in runbook

backlog.task: Develop internal web dashboard for key product usage KPIs
definition_of_done: Dashboard shows daily active users, feature adoption, and retention for both products
Filters for date range and product work within performance targets
At least two stakeholders review and accept dashboard views

backlog.task: Expose metrics API for programmatic access to aggregated analytics
definition_of_done: REST endpoints for core KPIs implemented with authentication
API returns correct data aligned with dashboard metrics
Rate limiting and basic logging enabled for all endpoints

backlog.task: Set up CI/CD pipeline for analytics platform components
definition_of_done: Automated tests run on each commit for pipelines and services
Deployments to staging and production are reproducible and documented
Rollback procedure tested at least once in staging

backlog.task: Implement access control and anonymisation for analytics data
definition_of_done: PII fields identified and either removed or anonymised in analytics layers
Role-based access configured for dashboards and warehouse schemas
Security officer signs off on access model and anonymisation approach

backlog.task: Create operational runbook for monitoring, incidents, and on-call
definition_of_done: Runbook describes key components, dashboards, and alert responses
Incident classification and escalation paths documented
Runbook stored in shared repository and linked from channel topic

backlog.task: Load historical backfill for last 6 months of product events
definition_of_done: Historical data loaded for both products without breaking daily loads
Data completeness validated against source counts
Stakeholders confirm historical trends look reasonable

backlog.task: Performance tuning for heavy queries and dashboards
definition_of_done: Top slow queries identified and optimised via indexes or model changes
Dashboard load times under 5 seconds for standard filters
Performance benchmarks recorded and shared with team

backlog.task: MVP launch review and handover to wider engineering and analytics teams
definition_of_done: MVP scope checklist completed and all critical issues resolved
Demo session held with recording and Q&A captured
Follow-up backlog for v2 created and prioritised

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on MVP scope, metrics, and event tracking spec before implementation starts.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the analytics MVP project and asking for agreement on scope and events.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final list of MVP metrics and dashboards to support at launch.
Sign off on the unified event tracking schema and conventions in A1.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Converge on architecture and pipeline design for ingestion and transformations.
threads_plan.trigger: Proposal message sharing initial architecture doc and asking for feedback on ingestion and modeling.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Choose the final architecture pattern for ingestion and transformation as documented in A3.
Agree on refresh frequency (daily vs near-real-time) for MVP pipelines.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define dashboard layout, KPIs, and performance expectations for the UI.
threads_plan.trigger: Post sharing dashboard wireframes and asking for comments on layout and KPI selection.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Lock the initial set of dashboard views and filters for the MVP release.
Confirm performance targets for dashboard load times and data freshness.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on access control, anonymisation, and compliance requirements.
threads_plan.trigger: Message from security stakeholder requesting review of access model and anonymisation policy.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the data access roles and anonymisation rules described in A5.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan launch, validate readiness, and capture follow-ups after MVP go-live.
threads_plan.trigger: Pre-launch message linking readiness checklist and proposing launch date and comms plan.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm MVP launch date and go/no-go based on A4 checklist status.

channel_rituals: Daily async standup thread with yesterday/today/blockers updates focused on T1–T12.
Twice-weekly architecture and data modeling review thread for open design questions.
Weekly dashboard and metrics review to validate outputs against stakeholder expectations.
Pre-launch readiness review using A4 checklist two days before any planned release.
Post-incident mini postmortem thread whenever a major data or availability issue occurs.
